The 1970&ndash;71 season was the 72nd season for [[FC Barcelona]]. 

The team finished second in [[La Liga]], though they were tied with champions [[Valencia CF]] on points. They won the [[1970–71 Copa del Generalísimo|Copa del Generalísimo]].<ref>{{cite book |title=Rothmans Football Yearbook 1971-72 |date=12 August 1971 |publisher=Queen Anne |isbn=978-0-362-00094-8 |url=https://archive.org/details/rothmansfootball0000unse_g4f5/page/850/mode/2up?q=barcelona |access-date=26 March 2026}}</ref>{{rp|850}}
